化探通过土壤样点的多指标测量寻找异常。比较样点与背景类中心的距离，为进一步采样提: Geochemical surveys combine several measurements at soil sampling sites. Distance from background cluster centers helps prioritize follow-up sampling.
高值不一定是油气异常。地质背景变化、污染与测量误差都能改变单个指标，需要结合多指: A high reading does not necessarily indicate hydrocarbons. Geological background, pollution and measurement error can alter individual indicators; inspect them together.
异常分数不是发现油藏的概率；聚类可能把密集异常团吸收为正常中心。: Anomaly scores are not discovery probabilities. Dense anomalous groups can be absorbed into background clusters.
合成归一化多指标采样；独立背景参考图用于拟合。: Synthetic normalized multivariate samples; fitting uses an independent background reference map.
查看采样位置和三个归一化指标；高值可能是异常，也可能来自背景。: Inspect sample locations and three normalized indicators. High readings can reflect either anomalies or background variation.
训练与测试不能混用: Keep training and test data separate
只使用参考图中已知背景样本拟合均值和标准差。: Fit means and standard deviations using known background samples from the reference map only.
观测值不等于地质真值: Observations are not geological ground truth
反复分配背景样本并更新 K 个中心，观察类内平方误差下降。: Alternate background sample assignments and updates to K centers. Observe the within-cluster sum of squares.
不要把训练效果当测试效果: Training fit is not test performance
计算测试点到最近背景中心的距离；超过阈值标记候选异常。: Measure each test point’s distance to the nearest background center. Flag points above the threshold.
比较多指标异常分数与单指标阈值，对候选样点进行人工成因复核。: Compare multivariate scores with a single-indicator baseline, then review possible causes at the candidate sites.
指标只代表本次合成数据: Metrics describe this synthetic dataset only
概念示意：圆点代表取样点，大小表示观测异常程度；不是油藏发现概率。: Concept: dots represent sampling sites; their size indicates unusual observations, not discovery probability.
取样点上的多个化学指标提供相互补充的信息。本例值已归一化，没有真实浓度单位。: Multiple chemical indicators provide complementary information at each site. These normalized values have no real concentration units.
仅使用训练参考图中已知背景样本拟合标准化和类中心，相当于事先调查过的背景区。: Scaling and centers are fitted only on known background samples in the reference map, representing a previously surveyed background area.
K-means 将相似背景样本聚到同一中心，迭代最小化类内平方距离。: K-means groups similar background samples and iteratively minimizes within-cluster squared distances.
测试样点到最近背景中心的距离。高分意味着与背景不同，成因仍需复查。: Distance to the nearest background center. A high score means the sample differs from the background; its cause still needs review.
三个归一化观测指标的合成采样地图。: A synthetic sampling map with three normalized observation channels.
背景参考分布下标准化的第二指标，不能用测试集重算标准化参数。: The second channel standardized using the background reference. Do not refit scaling on the test set.
可拖动迭代滑块查看真实保存的类中心更新；右图按该步的最近中心着色。: Use the iteration slider to inspect stored center updates. The map is colored by the nearest center at that step.
根据当前距离阈值输出的异常候选；阈值更严格通常减少候选。: Anomaly candidates at the current distance threshold. A stricter threshold usually reduces their number.
红色为错判样点；观察污染高值与漏检的不同位置。: Red indicates classification errors. Compare contamination-related high readings with missed anomalies.
旧地质图的填色区代表不同岩性。根据图例样本学习颜色中心，把扫描图转成可查询的区域: Colored regions on historical maps represent different lithologies. Learn color centers from labeled legend samples to convert a scan into regional masks.
图例建立颜色与岩性含义的对应。扫描偏色、纸张老化、文字覆盖会改变实际颜色，固定色: The legend links colors to lithologies. Scan color shifts, paper aging and annotations change observed colors and can defeat fixed thresholds.
首版处理岩性填色区，不包含 OCR；未做地理配准，只输出图像坐标。: This version handles lithology fills, without OCR or geographic registration. Outputs use image coordinates.
合成扫描图、图例标注样本与独立评估区域。: Synthetic scans, labeled legend samples and independent evaluation regions.
读取合成扫描图的三通道颜色；细线模拟文字或图件覆盖。: Read three-channel colors from a synthetic scan. Thin lines simulate text and overlaid map markings.
从独立训练图采集图例色彩样本，显示各类颜色的分布。: Sample labeled colors from the independent training map and inspect each class distribution.
根据标注样本拟合三类颜色中心，并用训练参数标准化。: Fit three color centers using labeled samples and standardize with training statistics.
按当前最小区域面积合并后的分类及图像边界线。: Classification and image boundaries after merging regions below the current minimum area.
检查区域类别 IoU；导出图像坐标标签，不将像素误作地理坐标。: Inspect per-class IoU and export image-coordinate labels. Pixels are not geographic coordinates.
概念示意：图例定义填色与岩性标签的对应。颜色变淡或扫描偏色会增加匹配难度。: Concept: the legend maps fill colors to lithologies. Fading and scan color shifts make matching harder.
图例中的颜色样本与地质含义对应。本例以参考图的带标签色块模拟已标注图例。: Legend colors carry geological meaning. Labeled patches in the reference map simulate a labeled legend.
每类标注样本的平均颜色向量，分类时寻找标准化空间中最近的颜色中心。: The average color vector of a labeled class. Classification selects the nearest center in standardized space.
最小区域面积以图像像元计。小连通区域会按周边类别合并，过大会消除真实小单元。: Minimum area is measured in pixels. Small connected regions are merged with neighboring classes; excessive merging removes genuine small units.
输出的边界线段只表示像素位置。未经控制点配准不能写成地理坐标。: Boundary segments describe pixel positions. Geographic coordinates require registration using control points.
模拟扫描图的 RGB 观测；深色格线代表覆盖与标注干扰。: Synthetic RGB scan observations. Dark grid lines represent overlaid markings.
参考图中被采样的色彩标注，作为图例学习样本。: Sampled color labels from the reference map serve as legend-learning examples.
最近类中心产生的原始分类，尚未执行面积合并。: Raw nearest-centroid classification before area merging.
合并后与真值的误差；错误可能减少，也可能因过度合并而增加。: Errors against ground truth after merging. Errors can decrease or grow through excessive merging.
遥感图像中的线性纹理可能来自构造，也可能是河道或道路。学习局部纹理模式，筛选需要: Linear textures in remote images may represent geological structures, rivers or roads. Local texture features help identify lineaments for expert review.
地层错动在地表可能呈现连续线性迹象。对比度、线状连续性与方向特征共同提供候选证据: Displacement may leave linear surface traces. Contrast, continuity and orientation together provide candidate evidence.
候选线不能直接确认为断层；道路、阴影与弱纹理会导致误检或漏检。: Candidate lines are not confirmed faults. Roads, shadows and weak textures can cause false positives or missed detections.
带标注的合成线状影像；训练与测试使用不同线系。: Labeled synthetic line imagery, with separate line networks for training and testing.
生成不同方位构造线与阴影干扰，训练与测试使用不同线系。: Generate lines with different orientations and shadow interference, using independent training and test networks.
从灰度像素计算的局部暗脊响应；亮色表示中心比邻域更暗。: Local dark-ridge response computed from grayscale pixels. Bright values mean the center is darker than its surroundings.
用训练图标注学习逻辑回归权重，实际迭代最小化交叉熵。: Learn logistic-regression weights from training labels by iteratively minimizing cross-entropy.
将像元分数阈值化，再删除太小的连通域，产生待核查线性掩膜。: Threshold pixel scores and remove tiny connected regions to produce a candidate line mask.
对照保留真值统计像素 F1；检查弱线漏检和阴影误检。: Compute pixel F1 against retained ground truth; inspect missed weak lines and shadow-related false positives.
概念示意：红色曲线代表道路或阴影干扰。线性纹理需要结合地质背景复核。: Concept: the red curve represents road or shadow interference. Linear textures need geological review.
影像中的线形对象只是候选证据。道路、河流和岩性接触也可以呈线性。: Linear objects are candidate evidence only. Roads, rivers and lithological contacts can also be linear.
演示先渲染带细线、阴影和噪声的灰度图，再从实际像素计算模型特征。: The demo renders thin lines, shadows and noise first, then computes features from those observed pixels.
中心像素比邻域平均更暗时，暗脊响应增大；宽阴影和细线的局部响应可能不同。: The response grows when the center pixel is darker than the neighborhood mean. Broad shadows and thin lines can respond differently.
邻域梯度的结构张量刻画纹理是否偏向同一方向。它不等于断层的地质产状。: A local gradient structure tensor measures directional coherence. It does not determine geological fault orientation.
渲染的灰度影像，暗线和阴影均存在于实际像素中。: Rendered grayscale imagery: both dark lines and shadows are present in the observed pixels.
逻辑回归在训练图标注上拟合后的分类分数；左图是真实交叉熵损失。: Scores from logistic regression fitted on training labels; the left plot shows actual cross-entropy loss.
候选分数阈值化并去掉小连通域后的掩膜。: The mask after thresholding candidate scores and removing small connected regions.
误差图按像素对照独立真值；背景干扰可能被误标为构造候选。: Pixel errors against independent ground truth. Background interference can be mislabeled as a lineament.
多波段观测把地表岩石转成可测量的数值。用少量标注样本生成岩性候选分区，帮助地质人: Multiband observations turn surface rocks into measurable values. A small labeled sample supports candidate lithology zones for field review.
岩性是岩石性质的组合；像元是一小块地表的观测。不同岩石在不同波段中的响应不同，阴: Lithology describes rock properties; each pixel observes a small surface area. Rocks respond differently across bands, while shadows alter those responses.
地表岩性候选不等于地下油藏；阴影、覆盖与少数类样本不足都会引起混淆。: Surface lithology candidates do not identify subsurface reservoirs. Shadows, cover and insufficient minority-class labels cause ambiguity.
合成三波段影像；独立训练图与测试图；每类人工标注样本。: Synthetic three-band imagery, independent training and test maps, and labeled samples for each class.
检查三个波段的响应与地表像元；训练图种子与测试图种子不同。: Inspect the three bands and surface pixels. Training and test maps use different random seeds.
从训练图按固定间隔采集标注样本；检查每个岩性类别是否被覆盖。: Sample labels at fixed intervals on the training map. Check that every lithology is represented.
用训练样本均值和标准差变换波段，避免高幅度通道主导距离。: Scale bands with training means and standard deviations so high-amplitude channels do not dominate distances.
计算测试像元到标注样本的距离，取 k 个最近邻进行多数投票。: Measure distances from each test pixel to labeled samples, then take a majority vote among its k nearest neighbors.
生成独立图的类别混淆矩阵和 IoU，定位阴影与边界错误。: Compute the test-map confusion matrix and IoU; inspect errors near shadows and boundaries.
概念示意：移动切面，观察地层上下关系。地表颜色不能唯一确定地下结构。: Concept: move the section to inspect layer relationships. Surface color does not uniquely determine subsurface structure.
砂岩、泥岩和灰岩描述岩石性质；本例的类别是教学标签，并不对应真实区块。: Sandstone, mudstone and limestone describe rock properties. These teaching labels do not represent a real field.
一个波段是一类电磁观测响应。演示用三通道合成值，不对应具体卫星的标定反射率。: A band is an electromagnetic observation channel. The demo uses three synthetic channels, not calibrated satellite reflectance.
图像中的一个格子代表一小块地表。点选像元可以查看观测、预测、真值和最近邻投票。: A pixel represents a small surface area. Select one to inspect observations, predictions, truth and neighbor votes.
训练使用独立参考图，测试使用另一随机图，邻近像元不会随机混入训练集。: Training uses an independent reference map and testing a separate random map, without randomly mixing adjacent pixels into training.
测试图的合成三通道观测。它与训练参考图来自不同随机种子。: Synthetic three-channel observations from a test map generated with a different seed than the reference map.
训练参考图：彩色格子是实际采样的标注位置，其余格子变暗。右侧训练样本与当前测试图: Training reference: colored cells are the sampled labels; other cells are dimmed. These samples are separate from the test map.
测试图第二通道经训练均值和标准差标准化后的响应；左图显示标准化后的通道统计。: Test channel 2 after scaling with training statistics. The left plot summarizes standardized channels.
kNN 投票后的测试分类，颜色与岩性图例一致。: Test predictions after kNN voting, colored according to the lithology legend.
红色格子是独立测试图中预测与真值不一致的位置。: Red cells mark disagreements between predictions and ground truth on the independent test map.
露头照片记录岩石表面的裂缝迹线。识别裂缝像素后清理、骨架化，并统计二维方向分布以: Outcrop photos record fracture traces on exposed rock. Detect and clean fracture pixels, skeletonize them and summarize 2D orientations for geological review.
裂缝是一条有宽度的暗纹，骨架化把它压缩为中心线。玫瑰图把大量迹线方向汇总为可读的: A fracture appears as a dark trace with width. Skeletonization reduces it to a centerline; a rose plot summarizes the trace orientations.
二维迹线方向不等于三维产状；无可靠比例尺时长度只以像素报告。: Two-dimensional traces do not determine 3D orientation. Without reliable scale, lengths are reported in pixels only.
合成露头纹理与裂缝标注；独立照片划分训练、测试。: Synthetic outcrop textures and fracture labels, with independent training and test images.
观察合成露头中的细线与阴影；训练与测试裂缝网络独立生成。: Inspect thin lines and shadows in the synthetic outcrop. Training and test fracture networks are generated independently.
像素邻域计算出的暗脊响应；强纹理和阴影也可能响应。: Dark-ridge responses computed from pixel neighborhoods. Strong textures and shadows may also respond.
逻辑回归从标注图学习裂缝特征权重，显示真实训练损失。: Logistic regression learns fracture feature weights from labels and displays the actual training loss.
对像元分数阈值化、移除小连通域，再执行细化得到中心骨架。: Threshold pixel scores, remove small connected regions, then thin the mask to its centerline skeleton.
按局部骨架估计 0—180° 轴向分布；交叉点不等于多条独立裂缝。: Estimate the local skeleton’s axial distribution over 0–180°. Junctions do not identify separate fractures.
概念示意：细纹代表可见裂缝迹线，粗红线代表干扰。改变视图不等于恢复三维产状。: Concept: thin lines are visible fracture traces; the thick red line is interference. Changing the view does not recover 3D orientation.
裂缝面与可见岩石表面相交形成二维迹线。本例只处理图像内的迹线。: A fracture plane intersects the exposed rock surface to form a 2D trace. This demo processes image traces only.
模型读入从实际灰度像素计算的暗度、暗脊响应和梯度方向一致性。: The model uses darkness, dark-ridge response and gradient coherence computed from observed grayscale pixels.
将有宽度的裂缝掩膜细化成中心线，减少宽度对方向统计的影响。: Thin a fracture mask into a centerline to reduce the effect of width on orientation statistics.
同一条迹线的 0° 和 180° 等价。方向图按 0—180° 汇总，不是三维走: A trace at 0° is equivalent to one at 180°. This 0–180° summary does not represent 3D strike and dip.
带噪声、阴影与裂缝的实际合成灰度图。: The observed synthetic grayscale image, including noise, shadows and fractures.
模型分类分数；左图显示训练损失而非测试准确率。: Classifier scores. The left plot shows training loss, not test accuracy.
连通域清理后的裂缝掩膜，白色是细化后的中心骨架。: The cleaned fracture mask, with its thinned centerline skeleton shown in white.
预测相对真值的错误位置；方向统计使用细化骨架，交叉处仍会存在歧义。: Prediction errors against ground truth. Orientations use the thinned skeleton; junctions remain ambiguous.
点击术语，查看它在当前案例中的含义。: Select a term to learn what it means in this experiment.
模型提供候选，地质解释与现场复核由专业人员完成。本页数值仅评价合成数据上的算法行: The model proposes candidates. Professionals provide geological interpretation and field verification. Metrics here evaluate behavior on synthetic data only.
